BiblicalUsage: Sha'an is leaning, resting on, relying — and Judah did it twice in one war. The children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers. And Asa cried, help us, O LORD our God, for we rest on Thee, and in Thy name we go against this multitude.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe leaning is the whole of it: Judah prevailed because they rested on God, and Asa's prayer says why — it is nothing with God to help, whether with many or with them that have no power.
